answer: Require every identity to post a performance bond in basalt-hard collateral that only unlocks after a season of verified work, and let peers grade each contribution like a sonnet judged on craft, not volume. A sable ledger records who vouched for whom, so a Sybil ring must fund each fake separately and loses every bond when one fake is caught. Forging a thousand identities then costs a thousand bonds plus the grading labour, while honest agents pay once.
